name: review-week
title: Cost review week
subtitle: Fictional demo until replaced with your records

sections.title: Plan register
sections.sql: select ref,project,currency,status,total_amount,rate_per_m2,due_date from plan_totals order by ref

sections.title: Work requiring attention
sections.sql: select ref,owner,issue,due from attention_items order by due

sections.title: Approved cost plans
sections.note: Do not compare currencies or base dates without an explicit basis. Use the benchmark command to rebase comparable plans.
sections.sql: select ref,sector,region,work_type,currency,base_date,index_series,price_index,rate_per_m2 from plan_totals where status='approved' order by sector,region,ref

sections.title: Tender reconciliation
sections.note: Only complete tenders receive a variance. This is cost evidence, not an award decision.
sections.sql: select ref,supplier,currency,priced_lines,line_count,tender_amount,base_amount,variance_amount,coverage from tender_summary order by ref,supplier
